app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRl.desc.source: Create new records in the given table in app "Attio"
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRl.desc.message: 在應用程式「Attio」的指定資料表中建立新記錄

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRl.short_desc.source: Create new records in the given table in app "Attio"
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRl.short_desc.message: 在應用程式「Attio」的指定資料表中建立新記錄

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.desc.source: This action creates a new note and attaches it to a specific record within an Attio object. Notes can be written in plain text or markdown format and include a title and content body. They serve as a way to document important information about records in your workspace.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.desc.message: 此動作會建立新的備忘錄，並將其附加至 Attio 物件中的特定記錄。備忘錄可以使用純文字或 Markdown 格式編寫，並包含標題和內文。其可用於記錄工作區中記錄的重要資訊。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: Enter the content for your note. This can be formatted according to the selected format type (plain text or markdown).
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 輸入備忘錄的內容。可以根據所選的格式類型 (純文字或 Markdown) 進行排版。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: The main body text of the note
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 備忘錄的主要內文文字

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: Choose whether the note content should be treated as plain text or markdown. Markdown allows for rich text formatting including headers, lists, links, and more.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 選擇備忘錄內容應視為純文字還是 Markdown。Markdown 支援豐富文字格式，包含標題、清單、連結等。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: The text format to use for the note content
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 備忘錄內容所使用的文字格式

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: Select the Attio object that contains the record you want to attach this note to. This defines which object type the note will be associated with.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 選擇包含您要將此備忘錄附加到的記錄之 Attio 物件。這定義了備忘錄將關聯的物件類型。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: The object that contains the record to attach the note to
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 包含要附加備忘錄之記錄的物件

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: Select the specific record within the parent object that this note should be attached to. Available options will be based on the parent object you selected.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 選擇父物件中應附加此備忘錄的特定記錄。可用選項將基於您選擇的父物件。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: The specific record to attach the note to
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 要附加備忘錄的特定記錄

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.source: Provide a title for the note. This will appear as the heading when viewing the note in Attio.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.optio.message: 提供備忘錄的標題。在 Attio 中查看備忘錄時，這將顯示為標題。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.short.source: Creates a new note attached to a specific record in Attio.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX25vdGU.short.message: 建立附加至 Attio 中特定記錄的新備忘錄。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX29iamVjdF9yZ.source: Create a new record in a specified object within your Attio workspace. This action allows you to define the object type and the attributes for the new record.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX29iamVjdF9yZ.message: 在您的 Attio 工作區的指定物件中建立新紀錄。此動作允許您定義新紀錄的物件類型和屬性。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX29iamVjdF9yZ.source: Choose the object type in which you want to create a new record. This can be a custom object or a standard object in your Attio workspace.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX29iamVjdF9yZ.message: 選擇您要在其中建立新紀錄的物件類型。這可以是 Attio 工作區中的自訂物件或標準物件。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX29iamVjdF9yZ.source: Create a new record in a specified object
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX29iamVjdF9yZ.message: 在指定的物件中建立新紀錄

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.source: Creates a new entry in a specified Attio list. Requires the list identifier, parent object reference, and attribute values to populate the entry.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.message: 在指定的 Attio 清單中建立新條目。需要清單識別碼、父物件參照以及用來填入該條目的屬性值。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.source: The API slug of the Attio list where the new entry will be created.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.message: 將要在其中建立新條目的 Attio 清單的 API 代稱（slug）。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.source: The Attio list to create entry in
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.message: 要在其中建立條目的 Attio 清單

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.source: The unique identifier of the parent record to which this list entry will be linked.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.message: 此清單條目將連結到的父紀錄的唯一識別碼。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.source: Create a new entry in an Attio list.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3RfZW50c.message: 在 Attio 清單中建立新條目。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.desc.source: This action creates a new task in Attio with content, deadline, completion status, and optional assignees. You can set the task content, specify a deadline date, mark it as completed or not, and assign it to one or more workspace members.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.desc.message: 此動作會在 Attio 中建立包含內容、截止日期、完成狀態以及可選負責人的新任務。您可以設定任務內容、指定截止日期、將其標記為已完成或未完成，並將其指派給一名或多名工作區成員。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.source: Enter the content or description for the task. This will be the main text describing what needs to be done.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.message: 輸入任務的內容或描述。這將是描述需要完成之事項的主要文字。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.source: The content or description of the task
Select one or more workspace members who will be assigned to this task. These members will be responsible for completing the task and will receive notifications about it.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.message: 選擇一名或多名將指派至此任務的工作區成員。這些成員將負責完成任務並收到相關通知。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.source: Workspace members to assign the task to
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.message: 指派此任務的工作區成員

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.source: Specify the date and time by which the task should be completed. This will be displayed in the task details and can be used for sorting and filtering tasks.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.message: 指定任務應完成的日期和時間。這將顯示在任務詳細資料中，並可用於排序和篩選任務。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.source: The deadline date for the task
Specify whether the task should be marked as completed when created. Default is false (task is not completed).
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.message: 指定在建立時是否應將任務標記為已完成。預設為 false（任務未完成）。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.optio.source: Whether the task is already completed

app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.short.source: Creates a new task in Attio with specified details.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Y3JlYXRlX3Rhc2s.short.message: 在 Attio 中使用指定詳細資料建立新任務。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.desc.source: Retrieve Notes from your Attio workspace.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.desc.message: 從您的 Attio 工作區擷取筆記。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.b.source: The number of notes to skip before starting to return results. Used for pagination. Default is 0.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.b.message: 開始傳回結果之前要跳過的筆記數量。用於分頁。預設為 0。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.b.source: The maximum number of notes to return. Default is 50. You can specify a value between 1 and 100.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.b.message: 欲傳回筆記的最大數量。預設為 50。您可以指定介於 1 到 100 之間的值。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.b.source: Maximum number of notes to return

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.c.source: The type of the parent object that this note is linked to. This is required to filter notes by their parent object.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.c.message: 此筆記連結到的父物件類型。依父物件篩選筆記時需要此項。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.c.source: The unique identifier of the parent record to which this note is linked. This is required to filter notes by their parent record.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X25vdGVz.option.c.message: 此筆記連結到的父紀錄的唯一識別碼。依父紀錄篩選筆記時需要此項。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.source: This action retrieves a single record from an Attio object by its record ID. You must specify both the object and the specific record ID you want to retrieve. This provides detailed information about the record including all its attributes and values.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.message: 此動作透過紀錄 ID 從 Attio 物件擷取單一紀錄。您必須同時指定物件以及欲擷取的特定紀錄 ID。這會提供關於該紀錄的詳細資訊，包含其所有屬性與值。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.source: Select the Attio object that contains the record you want to retrieve. This is required to identify which object to search in.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.message: 選擇包含您欲擷取紀錄的 Attio 物件。此為識別要在哪個物件中搜尋所必需。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.source: The Attio object to retrieve the record from
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.message: 擷取紀錄的 Attio 物件

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.source: Specify the unique identifier of the record you want to retrieve. This ID is specific to the object you've selected and will load available records based on your object selection.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.message: 指定您欲擷取紀錄的唯一識別碼。此 ID 專屬於您選取的物件，並會根據您的物件選擇載入可用紀錄。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.source: The ID of the specific record to retrieve
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.message: 要擷取的特定紀錄 ID

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.source: Retrieves a specific record from an Attio object.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X29iamVjdF9yZWNvc.message: 從 Attio 物件擷取特定紀錄。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.d.source: This action retrieves a single entry from an Attio list by its entry ID. You must specify both the list and the specific entry ID you want to retrieve. This provides detailed information about the entry including all its attributes and values.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.d.message: 此動作透過條目 ID 從 Attio 清單擷取單一條目。您必須同時指定清單以及您欲擷取的特定條目 ID。這會提供關於該條目的詳細資訊，包含其所有屬性與值。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.o.source: Specify the unique identifier of the entry you want to retrieve. This ID is specific to the list you've selected and will load available entries based on your list selection.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.o.message: 指定您欲擷取條目的唯一識別碼。此 ID 專屬於您選取的清單，並會根據您的清單選擇載入可用條目。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.o.source: The ID of the specific entry to retrieve
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.o.message: 要擷取的特定條目 ID

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.o.source: Select the Attio list that contains the entry you want to retrieve. This is required to identify which list to search in.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.o.message: 選擇包含您欲擷取條目的 Attio 清單。此為識別要在哪個清單中搜尋所必需。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.o.source: The Attio list to retrieve the entry from
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.o.message: 擷取條目的 Attio 清單

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.s.source: Retrieves a specific entry from an Attio list.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X2xpc3RfZW50cnk.s.message: 從 Attio 清單擷取特定條目。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2s.desc.source: This action retrieves a single task from Attio using its unique task ID. The response includes all task details such as content, completion status, deadline, linked records, assignees, and creation information.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2s.desc.message: 此動作使用唯一的任務 ID 從 Attio 擷取單一任務。回應包含所有任務詳細資料，例如內容、完成狀態、截止日期、連結的紀錄、負責人以及建立資訊。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2s.option.dG.source: Specify the unique identifier of the task you want to retrieve. The available task IDs will be loaded based on your previous object selection.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2s.option.dG.message: 指定您欲擷取任務的唯一識別碼。可用的任務 ID 將會根據您先前的物件選擇來載入。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2s.option.dG.source: The ID of the specific task to retrieve
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2s.option.dG.message: 要擷取的特定任務 ID

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2s.short_des.source: Retrieves a specific task from Attio by its ID.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2s.short_des.message: 依 ID 從 Attio 擷取特定任務。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.desc.source: This action retrieves a list of tasks from Attio with various filtering, sorting, and pagination options. You can filter tasks by linked records, completion status, and assignee, as well as control the order and number of results returned.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.desc.message: 此動作會從 Attio 擷取任務清單，並提供各種篩選、排序和分頁選項。您可以依連結紀錄、完成狀態和負責人篩選任務，以及控制傳回結果的順序和數量。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.Y.source: Filter tasks to only include those assigned to a specific workspace member.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.Y.message: 篩選任務，僅包含指派給特定工作區成員的任務。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.a.source: Filter tasks based on whether they are completed or not. Default is false (shows incomplete tasks).
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.a.message: 根據任務是否完成來篩選任務。預設為 false（顯示未完成的任務）。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.source: Specify the number of tasks to skip before starting to return results. Useful for pagination. Default is 0.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.message: 指定在開始傳回結果之前要跳過的任務數量。適用於分頁。預設為 0。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.source: Specify the maximum number of tasks to return in a single request. Default is 10.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.message: 指定在單一請求中傳回任務的最大數量。預設為 10。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.source: Maximum number of tasks to return
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.message: 要返回的最大任務數量

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.source: Filter tasks to only include those linked to a specific object type in Attio. When selected, you can further refine by specifying a particular record.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.message: 篩選任務，僅包含連結到 Attio 中特定物件類型的任務。選取後，您可以透過指定特定紀錄進行進一步細化。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.source: Filter tasks by linked object type
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.message: 依連結的物件類型篩選任務

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.source: Filter tasks to only include those linked to a specific record in the selected linked object. This option is only available after selecting a linked object.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.message: 篩選任務，僅包含連結到所選連結物件中特定紀錄的任務。此選項僅在選取連結物件後可用。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.source: Filter tasks by specific linked record
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.b.message: 按特定的連結記錄篩選任務

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.c.source: Specify the order in which tasks should be returned. 'Oldest First' sorts by creation date ascending, 'Newest First' sorts by creation date descending.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.option.c.message: 指定返回任務的排序順序。「最舊的優先」依建立日期升冪排序，「最新的優先」依建立日期降冪排序。

app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.short_de.source: Retrieves a list of tasks from Attio with filtering options.
app.QXR0aW8.action.Z2V0X3Rhc2tz.short_de.message: 從 Attio 檢索包含篩選選項的任務清單。

app.QXR0aW8.action.ZGVsZXRl.desc.source: Delete records from the given table in app "Attio"
app.QXR0aW8.action.ZGVsZXRl.desc.message: 從應用程式「Attio」中的指定資料表刪除記錄

app.QXR0aW8.action.ZGVsZXRl.short_desc.source: Delete records from the given table in app "Attio"
app.QXR0aW8.action.ZGVsZXRl.short_desc.message: 從應用程式「Attio」中的指定資料表刪除記錄

app.QXR0aW8.action.ZmluZF9saXN0X2VudHJpZ.source: Queries entries from a specific Attio list with support for filtering by attribute values, sorting by attributes, and pagination. Returns a list of entries matching the specified criteria.

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.de.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Attio** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.de.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證對 **Attio** 進行自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基礎 URL）、可選的查詢參數、標頭和請求內文。回應將以包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應內文的雜湊形式返回。

針對尚未在此應用程式上公開為第一級動作的端點使用此動作。

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/form/YAML 期望雜湊，XML/text 期望字串，multipart 期望檔案結構，binary 期望原始位元組。

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構（filename + content + mime_type）。架構會建立 multipart 封套並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 原封不動地將主體傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項和值類型來決定序列化方式

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆蓋，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量（字串/數字/布林值）的雜湊。

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Selects the body serialization mode and the corresponding `Content-Type` header. Changing this field reshapes the `body` editor - selecting JSON exposes a JSON editor, selecting Multipart Form exposes a file picker, and so on.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 選擇主體序列化模式及對應的 `Content-Type` 標頭。變更此欄位會重新配置 `body` 編輯器 — 選擇 JSON 會顯示 JSON 編輯器，選擇 Multipart 表單會顯示檔案選擇器，依此類推。

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: How the body is serialized and what Content-Type is sent
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 主體如何序列化以及傳送何種 Content-Type

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx HTTP 回應會作為正常的相應雜湊傳回（帶有實際狀態碼），而非引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。有助於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 — 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆蓋連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 正常傳回非 2xx 回應而非拋出例外

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 視為成功的 HTTP 狀態碼選擇性清單。若有設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作會拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。若未設定，則套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為（通常：2xx 為成功，非 2xx 則拋出例外）。

app.QXR0aW8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Response status codes treated as success
